exampleSentences.en: Language barriers made it hard for us to ask for directions.
exampleSentences.zh: 語言障礙讓我們很難開口問路。

exampleSentences.en: High tuition fees create barriers to higher education for low-income students.
exampleSentences.zh: 高昂的學費為低收入學生接受高等教育設下障礙。

barriers.mnemonicHint: barrier 像一根 bar 橫在路上，形成阻擋前進的障礙。

exampleSentences.en: Two barristers from upstairs joined us for coffee.
exampleSentences.zh: 樓上的兩名出庭律師和我們一起喝了咖啡。

exampleSentences.en: The study compares how barristers present evidence in criminal appeals.
exampleSentences.zh: 該研究比較出庭律師在刑事上訴中如何提出證據。

barristers.mnemonicHint: 在 bar 律師公會執業的 barrister

exampleSentences.en: My pottery will be featured in the community center's window.
exampleSentences.zh: 我的陶藝作品將在社區中心的櫥窗展出。

exampleSentences.en: The new findings will be featured in the journal's special issue.
exampleSentences.zh: 這些新發現將刊登於該期刊的特刊。

be featured.mnemonicHint: feature 是特色，be featured 是被突出呈現

exampleSentences.en: The cafe will be featuring local pastries throughout the holiday week.
exampleSentences.zh: 這間咖啡館將在整個假期週間主打本地糕點。

exampleSentences.en: Next month's symposium will be featuring recent advances in battery design.
exampleSentences.zh: 下個月的研討會將重點介紹電池設計的最新進展。

be featuring.mnemonicHint: be 加 featuring 表主動以某物為亮點

exampleSentences.en: A service charge has already been included in our bill.
exampleSentences.zh: 我們的帳單中已經包含服務費。

exampleSentences.en: Measures of household income have been included in the revised analysis.
exampleSentences.zh: 修訂後的分析已納入家庭收入的衡量指標。

been included.mnemonicHint: include 放進去，been included 表示已納入

being stuck.chinese: 正被困住；處於卡住狀態

exampleSentences.en: Being stuck in a crowded elevator made everyone anxious.
exampleSentences.zh: 受困在擁擠的電梯裡讓大家都很焦慮。

exampleSentences.en: Students described being stuck on the final equation despite understanding the theory.
exampleSentences.zh: 學生表示，儘管理解理論，仍卡在最後一道方程式。

being stuck.mnemonicHint: being 加 stuck，強調正在受困

exampleSentences.en: The minister offered benedictions to the newly married couples.
exampleSentences.zh: 牧師為新婚夫妻獻上祝福。

exampleSentences.en: The historian analyzed benedictions recorded in medieval wedding manuscripts.
exampleSentences.zh: 歷史學家分析了中世紀婚禮手稿中記載的祝禱詞。

benedictions.mnemonicHint: bene 好加 diction 說話，說好話就是祝福

exampleSentences.en: Regular exercise is beneficial to both physical and mental health.
exampleSentences.zh: 定期運動對身心健康都有益。

exampleSentences.en: Trade agreements can be mutually beneficial when properly structured.
exampleSentences.zh: 結構合理的貿易協議可以互利互惠。

beneficial.mnemonicHint: bene(good) + fic(do) + ial → 做好事的 → 有益的

exampleSentences.en: The hiking trail continues beyond the bridge.
exampleSentences.zh: 健行步道延伸到橋的另一端。

exampleSentences.en: The consequences extend beyond the immediate economic costs.
exampleSentences.zh: 其後果超越眼前的經濟成本。

beyond.mnemonicHint: be + yond 那一邊：在界線更遠處。

exampleSentences.en: The light switch offers a simple binary choice: on or off.
exampleSentences.zh: 電燈開關提供一個簡單的二元選擇：開或關。

exampleSentences.en: The exam asks students to convert a decimal number into binary notation.
exampleSentences.zh: 考題要求學生將十進位數字轉換成二進位表示法。

binary.mnemonicHint: bi 是二，binary 只有兩種狀態

exampleSentences.en: Someone tried to blackmail the shop owner with stolen photographs.
exampleSentences.zh: 有人企圖用偷來的照片勒索店主。

exampleSentences.en: The legal analysis distinguishes blackmail from legitimate commercial negotiation.
exampleSentences.zh: 這項法律分析區分了勒索與正當商業談判。

blackmail.mnemonicHint: 用黑暗秘密寄 mail 威脅，聯想勒索

exampleSentences.en: The empty apartment looked bleak without curtains or furniture.
exampleSentences.zh: 沒有窗簾或家具的空公寓看起來十分冷清。

exampleSentences.en: The report presents a bleak outlook for species in shrinking habitats.
exampleSentences.zh: 該報告對棲地日益縮減的物種提出了黯淡的前景。

bleak.mnemonicHint: bleak 聽似 black，景象黑暗黯淡

exampleSentences.en: The nurse took a small blood sample.
exampleSentences.zh: 護理師抽取了一小份血液樣本。

exampleSentences.en: Blood carries oxygen from the lungs to tissues throughout the body.
exampleSentences.zh: 血液把氧氣從肺部送到全身組織。

blood.mnemonicHint: blood 與 bleed 都和流血有關。

exampleSentences.en: She made the title bold so it was easy to see.
exampleSentences.zh: 她把標題設成粗體，讓它更容易看見。

exampleSentences.en: The government adopted a bold strategy to curb emissions.
exampleSentences.zh: 政府採取大膽策略以抑制排放。

bold.mnemonicHint: bold 的 b 像挺胸站立，記住「大膽」。

exampleSentences.en: I felt bored while waiting for the delayed bus.
exampleSentences.zh: 等候誤點的公車時，我覺得很無聊。

exampleSentences.en: Participants who became bored responded less carefully to the later questions.
exampleSentences.zh: 感到無聊的參與者回答後面題目時較不仔細。

bored.mnemonicHint: 人感到 bored，事情令人 boring

exampleSentences.en: The monk invited his brethren to share the donated bread.
exampleSentences.zh: 那名修士邀請弟兄們一起分享捐贈的麵包。

exampleSentences.en: The text describes how the brethren preserved manuscripts during the conflict.
exampleSentences.zh: 該文本描述弟兄們如何在衝突期間保存手稿。

brethren.mnemonicHint: 古式 brother 複數 brethren，指弟兄

exampleSentences.en: The broken handle makes this suitcase difficult to carry.
exampleSentences.zh: 壞掉的提把讓這個行李箱很難搬運。

exampleSentences.en: For analysis, the population was broken into five age groups.
exampleSentences.zh: 為了進行分析，研究人口被分成五個年齡組。

broken.mnemonicHint: break 的過去分詞 broken，已經破了

exampleSentences.en: Our washing machine has broken down before laundry day.
exampleSentences.zh: 我們的洗衣機在洗衣日前就故障了。

exampleSentences.en: The survey data are broken down by age, occupation, and region.
exampleSentences.zh: 調查資料依年齡、職業與地區分類呈現。

broken down.mnemonicHint: break down 向下垮掉，表示故障或拆解

exampleSentences.en: A burly mover carried our refrigerator up three flights of stairs.
exampleSentences.zh: 一名魁梧的搬運工把我們的冰箱扛上三層樓。

exampleSentences.en: The witness consistently described the suspect as a burly man with a beard.
exampleSentences.zh: 證人始終將嫌疑人描述為一名留鬍子的魁梧男子。

burly.mnemonicHint: burly 聯想 bulky，體格粗壯

glosses.engaged: 忙碌的；使用中的，被佔用的
glosses.inclusive: 包容的；涵蓋廣泛的；包括在內的
